How I work
Customer Success works when customers can connect product usage to a business outcome.

My approach begins with discovery: understanding priorities, stakeholders, workflows, adoption blockers and the customer's definition of success.

I turn that context into focused success plans, enablement, health reviews, QBRs and cross-functional actions that make progress visible and accountable.
